limit-basic-dc.title: Basic: DC input
limit-basic-dc.prompt: Set the maximum DC input to the final stage for a Basic operator.
limit-basic-dc.success: 250 W DC input for Basic. Advanced allows 1000 W.

limit-adv-ssb.title: Advanced: SSB
limit-adv-ssb.prompt: Set the maximum SSB peak envelope power for an Advanced operator.
limit-adv-ssb.success: 2250 W PEP for Advanced; 560 W for Basic.

limit-basic-carrier.title: Basic: FM and CW
limit-basic-carrier.prompt: Set the maximum carrier power for a Basic operator on FM.
limit-basic-carrier.success: 190 W carrier for emissions other than SSB.
